author: toed
body:
Hey y'all.

I'm new around Avicus. I play on and off, mainly when I'm tired of the toxicity of other communities (cough cough Overcast cough cough). There are a huge issue that not only irritates me, but degrade the overall quality of Avicus. Keep in mind, I have only played Nexus.

Your games are usually shorter than 3 minutes. When I first joined avicus, I was incredibly bored, because all that would happen in the match would be
1. Run to front lines
2. Get in bow battle
3. Fall back to gapple
4. Match ends. 
Even when playing today, this is literally all that happens. There's no point in crafting armor, its all about rushing. I'm not against rushing, but there does have to be a certain skill level required to break a monument. If you play a map with size 40v40 with only 6 players, there will be little pvp, and basically just solo players running to the monuments. Avicus currently has a serious problem with having a large player base (only about 120 people on Nexus at any given time), and the main reason is that people quickly see that Avicus matches have little action, and mainly consist of solo pushes for monuments on huge maps. It might be fun for the current player base to rush and rush and rush and buff up their monuments stats, but for the average player, it's incredibly boring. 

Next, please, for the love of god, add a team chat. There's no way to communicate with anyone without the other team knowing, and that really detracts from the team aspect and is one of the reasons that Avicus is so solo rush oriented. 

Mainly the first point, but also the second point must be addressed. In order for Avicus to expand as a server, they need to fix these things. In no particular order, here are a couple of solutions:
1. Replace map repository with smaller maps
2. Cut down number of servers
3. Modify maps in order to make defense more appealing (put things closer to spawn)
4. Create something that doesn't allow the map to begin unless there is a minimum capacity
5. Team chat
6. Chat Filter (lotta swearing going on in some cases)
7. Expanding into more gamemodes (Capture the Wool, Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, Destroy the Core)
8. Send Toed free cake because hot damn this is a lot of solutions.

replies.author: SnowSX3
replies.body:
Nexus is TDM.
Where the point is to kill people, so there would naturally be "rushers" in Nexus.
Can I suggest you play Nebula?
It hosts DTM maps. I think you'll find it more better for your play style.

To talk in team chat,, do /c t
And to talk in global chat, do /c g

And thanks for those suggestions.

Currently, we're working on some of them right now!
The next big update, the Omega update, will be released very soon, so you'll see new features added to Avicus in no time.

replies.body:
Your games are usually shorter than 3 minutes. When I first joined avicus, I was incredibly bored, because all that would happen in the match would be
Map Developers are trying to fix this, but reading off your list you played MCZone maps. I really don't recommend that for starters.

Next, please, for the love of god, add a team chat. 
We have one, /c t. Just nobody wants to use it...

1. Replace map repository with smaller maps We want diversity, we have too many small maps anyway imo.
2. Cut down number of servers It's been done twice, it'll be done again.
3. Modify maps in order to make defense more appealing (put things closer to spawn) Help us out on this one! We're trying to introduce maps like this, and even I have tried many concepts regarding defense. It usually just still doesn't encourage players though, which I don't understand. The layout is difficult to perfect.
4. Create something that doesn't allow the map to begin unless there is a minimum capacity Already added.
5. Team chat Already added.
6. Chat Filter (lotta swearing going on in some cases) More trouble than it's worth. We had one, but it was decided to be removed and it upset the community having it in the first place due to false censors and how hard it was to keep up with. Just gotta report.
7. Expanding into more gamemodes (Capture the Wool, Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, Destroy the Core) Already have the first 2, more gamemodes are to be discussed.

replies.author: Goodnighht
replies.body:
play Walls that's has a lot more of what It seems you are looking for. :). You should come play, we will welcome you, plus we have like the same 20 people that play every day. It's nise to see other players come and play (and stay playing :P)

You have to create your own gear to win.
There is lots of PvP, that's another way to get gear.
The only down side to this is the 10 minute wait before the walls drop, but this gives you plenty of time to get what you need and be ready for battle.

We can also teach you some of the maps, we aren't going to tell you everything. ;) There are still secrets you will have to find yourself.
Watch out for Stompers when you are playing. basically anything in the sky.
Stomper is the level 32 kit. You can use the /stats command to look at other peoples level. /stats user (name)
A Stomper does not take fall damage and it transfers the fall damage they
would take too players near them. My point is don't take a skybase from under unless you KNOW 100% that they are not stomper. Being stomped is not fun. Anyone can agree on that.
Also, WATCH OUT for Polar_Express. If he is playing a game avoid him. :P. He's too good. In other words, you don't WANT to fight him...
It's good to look at all of the kits, and know what they give/do so that you can tell people apart based on how they act when they are fighting you. If they are trying to get high ground, they are most likely stomper. If they keep putting water on them selves after each time you hit them, or want to fight in water then they are most likely posiden.
Last thing, Cow is NOT good. You can eat grass but the saturation is 0... you eat the grass and within 10 seconds its gone (not  moving) 
 Glad to help :)                                              -Micahb222000
